params.body: In customer mode the Stocklist render took 2.1 s against 0.2 s without: rest_of_render 1.9 s, which was getFlexLeaseInfo() for the twenty cards, a live POST to FlexLease on every render (live since flexlease went into OUTBOUND_ALLOW today). Its result, flexleasePrices, was passed to the view and read by no template; the card shows only the Flexlease badge. Removed. Shane saw the list keep loading because his session was in customer mode.
params.title: Stocklist: customer mode no longer calls FlexLease per render (1.9 s for nothing)
